Petition title: Petition calling to [?] the expensive health insurance given exclusively to Majlis members and not available to the general public

Petition reference number: EPT202600052

Related areas: Fundamental rights, Health and wellbeing, [?] Equality, Finance

Submitted by: Mohamed Saud

Details:

Law No. 5/2013, the People's Majlis Privileges and Powers Act, states in (a) of Chapter 7 on members' financial benefits that every member of the People's Majlis, the member's wife/husband and children under 18 years of age must be enrolled in an insurance scheme under which they can receive medical treatment in the Maldives, SAARC countries and ASEAN countries. And (b) of Chapter 8 (Retirement Benefits) of the same Act states that every person whose membership of the People's Majlis has ended must be provided medical treatment under the [?] health insurance scheme for members of the People's Majlis.

As a result of these laws [?] submitted by Majlis members [?], public money must be spent for life on insurance enabling medical treatment in the Maldives, SAARC countries and ASEAN countries for current and former members, their wives/husbands and children under 18, as well as for everyone who has served as a member. That is 19 countries in total, including Malaysia, Thailand and Singapore.

Accordingly, 100000000 [?] rufiyaa was spent on Majlis members' health insurance premiums for 2015-2025. And giving this insurance to members [?] while in office and to every member for life continues even today,
